summary: Synthwave: 80–118 BPM 80s retro, gated snare on 2 and 4, analog pads and arpeggios, minor i–VI–VII
body: Drums: straight rock beat on a drum machine, big gated-reverb snare on 2 and 4.
Bass: 8th-note pulses on the root (an arpeggiated synth bass).
Harmony: minor, i–VI–VII or i–v–VI–VII; analog pads, brassy stabs, arpeggios.

Apply: pattern/basic-rock on the drums, then pattern/prog-synthwave-common-1 on the keys four bars later. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 80–118 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one

key.about: the project's key; leave out to estimate it from the notes
